title: Stocks Rotate as Tech & Chip Shares Slide
text: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Charles Schwab Chief Investment Strategist Liz Ann Sonders, IDC Senior Director, Data & Analytics Nabila Popal, Susquehanna Senior Equity Research Analyst Mehdi Hosseini, KPMG US Chair & CEO Tim Walsh, Envestnet CIO Dana D’Auria, Hirtle & Co Founder & Executive Chair Jon Hirtle, Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management President & CEO Ross Gerber, Blue Sky Productions President John McElroy, & Porsche CEO Michael Leiters. (Source: Bloomberg)
